note: Under New Zealand law all Niueans are New Zealand citizens, so their passport is New Zealand's. The routes modelled are New Zealand's, for an application to the Department of Internal Affairs as from New Zealand; whether an application lodged from Niue pays New Zealand's fee or the fee from overseas is a lead.

sources.title: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, Niue
sources.said: under New Zealand law, all Niueans are New Zealand citizens
